acids, beer; agg. after ices.

 Itching, sticking at anus.
 Retained, scanty, red or bloody

 Cystitis.
 Urethral chill.
 Orchitis.
 Suddenly suppressed menses.

whistling cough, agg. from
every inspiration.

drinking.
 Laryngitis.
 Croup with fever.
 Violent rushes of blood to
chest.
  Pneumonia.
 Stitches in chest.
 Oppression of left chest.
 Pleurisy.
 Heart feels swelled.
 Carditis.
 Complaints of heart worse
from sitting erect.
 Palpitation, anxious; with pain
down l. arm.
 Red finger-tips.
 Powerless legs.
 Red, shining swelling.
 DRY, HOT SKIN, or as if ice
water on it.
 Miliary eruptions.
 Sleepless and nervous.

forcible and tumultuous or
wiry.

 Arterial tension (Ver-v.).
 CHILL; in waves; alternates
with heat.
 HIGH FEVER.
 Dry, burning heat; in eyelids;
nose, mouth, throat, lungs; on
palms; must uncover.
 Sweat : on uncovered parts;
wants covers; drenching.
 Back and sacrum feel bruised.
 Remote effects of fright (OP.).
 Cries out and grasps genitals.
